title: Vagabond Cruise
specs: Along the way, help spot the Atlantic Bottlenose Dolphin as they swim, play and feed with the tide.

Hilton Head Island, located in South Carolina, is known for its stunning coastline, rich history, and diverse wildlife, including the playful Atlantic bottlenose dolphins that often swim near its shores.

quotes.author: Leslie Williams
quotes.text: We went on "Spirit Of Harbourtown" for a day in Savannah.. The captain and crew did an amazing job and were having a great time along with everyone else. I would definitely recommend this cruise as it's a fun way to visit Savannah while you're in Hilton Head..

quotes.author: Meredith Scarfone
quotes.text: Went on a dolphin watch and it was a really nice experience for us and our almost 4 year old. The staff was very professional, friendly, attentive and knowledgeable. Was such a nice scenic relaxing ride in between the excitement of seeing the dolphins.

quotes.author: Irene Town
quotes.text: Had an awesome evening with Vaptain Justin and all of the crew. Saw a pod of dolphins and an amazing sunset and a great storm brewing. Lovely bunch of men who took great care of us. Will do this again when we comeback. Thank you Vagabond❤️
